title: gh-workflow Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the gh-workflow plugin — comprehension layer, merge behavior, conflict resolution, Git conventions, release settings, timeouts, and review parameters.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for IDE validation

gates.description: Human gate triggers for high-stakes decisions during AI-driven workflow execution

newDependencies.description: Gate for new entries in dependency files (package.json, requirements.txt, Gemfile, go.mod, Cargo.toml, .gitmodules)

securityChanges.description: Gate for changes to security-related files (*auth*, *security*, *permission*, *token*, *secret*, *crypto*, *session*, .env*)

schemaChanges.description: Gate for data model or schema changes (migrations, schema files, model definitions)

apiSurfaceChanges.description: Gate for public interface changes (routes, function signatures, command/skill/agent files)

scopeDeviations.description: Gate for changes outside the expected impact area from the issue

ambiguousRequirements.description: Gate for acceptance criteria requiring interpretation (vague terms, contradictions)

customTriggers.description: Glob patterns that trigger custom gates (e.g., ["*.proto", "**/migrations/*", "config/deploy/*"])

dir.description: Directory for decision journal files (relative to project root). Must be a non-empty relative path.

sensitivityDefault.description: Default sensitivity for new journal entries. 'public' entries appear in PR bodies; 'internal' entries are redacted.

thresholdFull.description: Diff size (lines changed) that triggers a full report instead of minimal

sessionSave.description: Whether to save Q&A session transcripts after gh-explain

includeDiff.description: Whether to load the diff into context automatically during gh-explain

commands.description: Per-command feature toggles for comprehension layer features

ghStartFamiliarityPrompt.description: Show code familiarity question during gh-start

ghPrDecisionSummary.description: Include decision summary in PR body during gh-pr

conflictResolution.description: Merge conflict resolution settings for gh-resolve

autoResolveTrivial.description: Automatically resolve trivial conflicts (non-overlapping changes in different sections) without asking the user

maxConflictFiles.description: Maximum number of conflicting files before suggesting an alternative approach (e.g., rebasing in smaller steps)

conventions.description: Git conventions for branch naming, commit messages, and validation

branchPatterns.description: Branch naming templates. Use {N} for issue number and {desc} for kebab-case description.

additionalBranchTypes.description: Additional branch type patterns beyond the core three (feature, fix, docs). Keys must not duplicate core branchPatterns keys. Values are templates with {N} and {desc} placeholders. Example: {"refactor": "refactor/issue-{N}-{desc}", "chore": "chore/issue-{N}-{desc}"}

release.description: Release and tagging settings for gh-release

tagPrefix.description: Prefix for version tags (e.g., 'v' produces 'v1.2.3', empty string produces '1.2.3')

timeouts.description: Timeout and iteration limits for verification and quality checks

devServerStartup.description: Seconds to wait for dev server to become ready

e2eTest.description: Timeout in seconds for E2E test suite execution

verificationScript.description: Timeout in seconds for verification script execution

qualityCheckMaxIterations.description: Maximum fix-verify iterations for lint/test/typecheck before escalating to user

review.description: Code review and reviewer suggestion settings

firstTouchLineThreshold.description: Lines added in a single diff that flags a file as first-touch AI pattern

activityLookbackDays.description: Days to look back for contributor activity when suggesting reviewers

activityFallbackDays.description: Extended lookback window when no activity found within activityLookbackDays (should be >= activityLookbackDays)

automation.description: Settings for autonomous workflow commands like gh-start-auto

maxReviewIterations.description: Maximum review-fix iterations in gh-start-auto before escalating to user
